content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Ann Arbor

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review the specific education and hours-of-experience benchmarks for your background. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications before enrollment and help you understand any gaps.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our sessions are scheduled to fit working professionals in Ann Arbor. You'll cover all five process groups and knowledge areas required by PMI in an interactive, cohort-based environment with expert instructors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application completion and eligibility documentation. PMI reviews and either approves or requests additional information within a set timeframe.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours. You'll sit for the PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in or near Ann Arbor. Our students benefit from targeted review sessions covering high-priority domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification lasts three years. You'll earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved learning activities, volunteer work, or teaching to maintain your credential. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses and resources to keep your skills current and your certification active.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
